Data Browser

A tool for searching and publishing structured collections. Researchers can inspect tables, filter records, and share results through a web interface or an API.

It accepts common tabular formats and supports additional importers and visualisations through extensions.

Collection Tools

Small utilities for converting research material into queryable tables, with repeatable import steps and a record of the original source.
